minor.issue: Handler used `if not f:` after a Mongo find_one with projection `{_id:0, quote_hidden:1}`. For a feedback doc that had never been hidden, the projection returned `{}` (truthy-empty), which is falsy in Python → endpoint returned 404 'Comment not found' even though the comment exists. First Hide click thus never succeeded for brand-new comments. FIXED in-place by changing to `if f is None:`.

Harden `CtaLink` (Initiatives.jsx:10) against missing `cta_link`: `to.startsWith('https://')` crashes the whole /initiatives + /initiatives/{slug} tree with a React runtime error if a program document is missing cta_link. _check_streaks (server.py ~5518) marks only `attended` as streak-advancing and `no_show` as streak-breaking, but silently ignores unmarked attendance. If a middle session is never marked, run resets to 0 — which matches the spec but is non-obvious. Add an inline comment.

_next_session filters `published:True` but does not filter out the current program itself. In practice `start_date>today` already excludes the just-ended session (end_date is in past). OK, but add a comment noting the implicit guarantee.
_program_ratings scans ALL session_feedback and ALL programs on every public /api/programs and /api/programs/{slug} call. For large catalogs, cache for 60s (noted iter-19 too).

rca of the issue: admin_hide_quote (POST /api/admin/feedback/{fid}/hide-quote) returned 404 'Comment not found' for existing feedback docs that had no `quote_hidden` field yet. Root cause: `find_one({'id':fid}, {'_id':0,'quote_hidden':1})` with the inclusive projection returns `{}` (empty-but-non-None) for docs missing `quote_hidden`. The handler then evaluated `if not f:` which is True for `{}` — raising 404 even though the document was found. Reproduction: POST on a fresh session_feedback doc from either curl or the UI's Hide-from-highlights button. Fix: `if f is None:` (applied at server.py:5569). Verified via pytest + UI toggle (3 feedback comments cycled Hide→Show→Hide).
